name: stewie-web
description: STEWIE web app: rover operations and EVA navigation over one store and clock (RW-70, D-R10).

scripts.build:engine: cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p stewie-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/engine/pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/stewie_wasm.wasm
